import pandas as pd

path = "budget.xlsx"
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"=== Sheet: {name} ===")

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

MAIN = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
REL = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"
PKG = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}"

def col_to_idx(ref):
    letters = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)", ref).group(1)
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
    return idx - 1

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall(f"{MAIN}si"):
            text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter(f"{MAIN}t"))
            shared.append(text)

    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    rels_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
    rel_map = {rel.get("Id"): rel.get("Target") for rel in rels_root.findall(f"{PKG}Relationship")}

    for sheet_el in wb_root.findall(f".//{MAIN}sheet"):
        rid = sheet_el.get(f"{REL}id")
        target = rel_map[rid]
        path = target if target.startswith("xl/") else "xl/" + target
        sheet_root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {sheet_el.get('name')} ({path}) ===")
        for row in sheet_root.iter(f"{MAIN}row"):
            for c in row.findall(f"{MAIN}c"):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find(f"{MAIN}v")
                if v is None:
                    val = None
                else:
                    raw = v.text
                    if t == "s":
                        val = shared[int(raw)]
                    elif t == "str":
                        val = raw
                    else:
                        val = raw
                print(f"{ref}: {val!r} (type={t})")
